assessment.nobel_worthiness: Induced degradation turned a biological process, ubiquitin-proteasome-dependent proteolysis, into a designable chemical reaction: a bifunctional or glue-like small molecule brings a target and an E3 ligase together. It gives biologists a general tool for removing proteins, including ones without a druggable active site, and it has changed drug discovery. The thalidomide-cereblon mechanism supplies the mechanistic chemistry for molecular glues.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies launched the PROTAC concept and the first proof of principle. Handa (with Ito) identified cereblon as the thalidomide target, which explains glue degraders mechanistically. Ciulli, Gray, Sakamoto and Kim also made important contributions, so a three-person limit forces hard choices and leaves the glue and PROTAC halves unevenly credited.
assessment.maturity: Many independent groups have reproduced the principle, and degraders are in advanced clinical trials, so the field is mature enough. Clinical approval is still pending, which could argue for waiting.
uncertainties: Whether to recognize PROTACs and molecular glues together or only one branch
Priority and credit among Crews, Deshaies, Ciulli, Gray and the cereblon discoverers
Clinical benefit is not yet established by an approved degrader (as far as I know)

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editors chemically convert one base into another at a defined genomic site without a double-strand break, by engineering deaminase enzymes onto a programmable DNA-binding protein. This is a clean enzymology and nucleobase-chemistry achievement, and a general tool for genome work, with direct therapeutic relevance to correcting point mutations. Concern remains that genome editing was recognized by the 2020 Chemistry prize.
assessment.attribution: Liu led the work, and Komor and Gaudelli were the lead trainees on cytosine and adenine base editors. Attribution is fairly clean. Kondo and Nishida's earlier deaminase-based editing is a competing claim that would complicate a configuration.
assessment.maturity: Widely adopted and independently reproduced in many labs and organisms, with first clinical applications emerging. Long-term safety and off-target (including RNA and bystander) effects are still being characterized.
uncertainties: Overlap with the CRISPR recognition in 2020 and whether the committee sees this as a new chemistry discovery

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Quantitative, large-scale mass spectrometry made the proteome measurable, turning cellular state into numbers, including post-translational modifications. As someone who relies on LC-MS/MS quantification, I regard it as foundational for measuring biological chemistry, in the same spirit as the electrospray and MALDI recognition in 2002.
assessment.attribution: Mann (SILAC and high-resolution workflows), Aebersold (targeted and quantitative methods, SRM and SWATH) and Yates (shotgun and MudPIT) are the three strongest-credited pillars. Hunt, Heck and Gygi also contributed, so exclusion is real.
assessment.maturity: Highly mature, universally used, and independently confirmed across thousands of studies. Timing is not premature.
uncertainties: The proteomics field is broad, so the prize wording and attribution could be contested
Instrumentation (Orbitrap) versus methodology credit may split

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Massively parallel sequencing by synthesis, based on reversible terminators and single-molecule or cluster detection, transformed biology and medicine and rests on well-defined nucleotide chemistry. The impact is difficult to overstate.
assessment.attribution: Balasubramanian and Klenerman originated the Solexa chemistry and platform and are the cleanest two-person configuration. Rothberg, Mayer, Ju and others have claims for competing platform technologies, so the credit is contested.
assessment.maturity: Fully mature with decades of independent use. If anything, recognition is overdue.
uncertainties: Competing platforms (pyrosequencing, other approaches) complicate who is decisive
Sequencing methods already received the 1980 and other recognition, so the committee may see this as less novel

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Reversible methylation of mRNA and the writer, eraser and reader machinery established a new layer of regulation. It links an RNA chemical modification to function, and it is a nucleotide-chemistry story I find attractive. It would extend the epitranscriptomic concept to cell biology and disease.
assessment.attribution: He (identified FTO as an m6A demethylase and proposed reversibility), Jaffrey (m6A mapping, and later debates on cap m6Am) and Rechavi/Dominissini (transcriptome-wide maps) are the likely core. Several others, including Yang and Jia, could share the credit.
assessment.maturity: Substantial independent replication, but there are known methodological controversies about antibody mapping and demethylase substrate specificity, and the physiological interpretation is still evolving.
uncertainties: Disputed demethylase specificity and mapping artifacts
Whether this is chemistry or biology prize territory
Crowded credit and a three-person limit

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Orthogonal aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase/tRNA pairs allow site-specific incorporation of noncanonical amino acids in living cells, turning protein translation into a programmable chemical system. It gave biologists a general tool and opened the way to chemically defined proteins.
assessment.attribution: Schultz established the first in vivo systems and the concept; Chin extended it to eukaryotes, quadruplet codons and genome-scale recoding. Wang, Mehl and Yokoyama are also important, so some allocation is unresolved.
assessment.maturity: Mature and widely used, with independent reproduction. Therapeutic and industrial uses are still developing.
uncertainties: Overlap and priority between Schultz and Wang or Mehl
Impact is mainly methodological, with fewer landmark discoveries so far

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles solved the delivery problem for nucleic-acid drugs and enabled siRNA therapy and the mRNA vaccines. The chemistry of pKa-tuned lipids is central and the biomedical impact is very large. The 2023 Medicine prize recognized the mRNA modification side, which may make the committee think the delivery side is also due.
assessment.attribution: Cullis and colleagues developed the ionizable-lipid LNP formulation concept; Anderson and Langer contributed lipidoid and screening approaches. Credit is shared across academic and company groups and patents, which is difficult.
assessment.maturity: Strongly confirmed by clinical approval and use, so timing is good. The attribution is the main obstacle.
uncertainties: Contested credit across academia and industry
Whether the committee regards it as a formulation advance rather than a chemical discovery

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Shokat showed that a mutant cysteine in KRAS G12C could be targeted covalently, finding a pocket that had been considered undruggable, which led to approved drugs. Earlier chemical genetics of analog-sensitive kinases is a general tool. It is a clear and elegant mechanism-driven chemistry result with direct patient impact.
assessment.attribution: A single-person attribution is clean and plausible, although the clinical drugs were developed by industry teams building on his work.
assessment.maturity: Clinical validation exists through approved KRAS G12C inhibitors, and the approach has been independently reproduced. Resistance and durability of benefit are still being studied.
uncertainties: A one-person prize leaves out the many who developed the drugs
Breadth of the discovery beyond KRAS G12C
